result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but several horizontally scrolling elements are visibly clipped at the screen edges, making content look cut off; the top-right circular control also appears blank except for a red dot.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel clips the third card on the right, truncating the restaurant name to 'Trattoria Piccol...' and cutting off the image/delivery details.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel affordance, reduce card width, or ensure edge truncation looks intentional with fade/gradient and consistent peek spacing.

issues.description: The category filter row shows a barely visible sliver of the next chip after 'Healthy' at the right edge, which looks like accidental overflow.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent horizontal padding and either hide the partial chip or make the peek amount deliberate and balanced.

issues.description: In 'Popular right now', the second promo card is cut off by the bottom of the viewport/nav area, showing only the pizza image top and making the section feel unfinished in a static view.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the first fully visible card fits above the fold or add spacing/scroll hint so partial content reads as intentional.

issues.description: The top-right circular control appears mostly empty/light gray with only a tiny red dot, so its purpose or icon is unclear.
issues.suggestion: Add a recognizable profile/notification icon or avatar and align the badge consistently.
